meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
I'm writing down "612 words" and "11:52 PM." What date was that edit, and can I see the page myself?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." Either the zero is withdrawn or it isn't, Hale, and whether I'm happy has nothing to do with it. I want that in an email today, along with confirmation that nothing is on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You said in our meeting that you would remove the zero. I still expect written confirmation that it is withdrawn and that nothing is placed on Owen's record. I expect it today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with the zero withdrawal offered by you but hedged and nothing firm agreed.
What moved her: nothing, because "612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM" came with no date and no page she could check.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because you dropped your own evidence before answering her question about the date.
Try next time: when she asks what date the edit was and to see the page, answer with the date and show it before you offer anything.
